name: scene-night
prompt: Change the time of day to a clear night and keep everything else exactly: the same camera, composition, giant brown corrugated carton, buildings, shops, trees, van, handcart and tiny people in the same places. Deep navy-blue night sky with a few small faint stars and the distant hills as dark silhouettes. Warm yellow light glowing from shop windows and a few small street lamps. The glowing green path at the carton's foot is brighter and lights the lower part of the carton's front face from below with a soft green glow. The ground and buildings are dark and moody, lit only by the shop windows, street lamps and the green path. Every shop signboard is a plain dark board with no letters, numbers or symbols on it. Tilt-shift miniature diorama photograph style, no text.
